items.title: Susan Sarandon and Hannah Einbinder detained at a Netanyahu protest
items.summary: Susan Sarandon and Hannah Einbinder were detained by police in New York while protesting Benjamin Netanyahu's speech at the UN General Assembly. A photo of Sarandon surrounded by NYPD officers got 73K likes, and Pop Base's report of the detentions got 157K.
items.author: @WearThePeaceCo

post.name: WearThePeace
post.text: Actress Susan Sarandon being arrested earlier today for protesting Benjamin Netanyahu’s speech at the United Nations. One is speaking out against genocide, one is committing it. One was arrested, one was not.
